description: Agile user story review — value, independence, testability, negotiability, vertical slicing, and KUBA stage clarity.

dimensions.description: User value and benefit are explicit
Story is deliverable with minimal hidden sequencing dependency
Acceptance criteria are concrete and verifiable
Scope is appropriately small and open to refinement
Delivers end-to-end user-visible value rather than a horizontal layer
Clearly maps to Know, Understand, Believe, or Act stages
